notes.title: Major version overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]Major Update for [i]Stardust Origins[/i][/h1][p]Commanders, it’s been a while! And we’re back with the [b]biggest update since launch[/b].
The galaxy just got sharper, smoother, and louder.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The headline feature[/b][/h3][h3][i]Full support for modern HDMI displays[/i]: 2K, 4K, and even 8K screens now scale beautifully thanks to our brand-new [b]UI scaling system[/b]. Whether you’re playing on a laptop or a giant TV, your cockpit now looks crystal-clear.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/6d9450c16060ecaecac28461bc3b6a676434c71d.png"][/img][/p][p]But that’s not all. This update also brings [b]a long list of fixes, improvements, and optimizations[/b] to make your adventures in Stardust Origins better than ever.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Highlights[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Scalable UI[/b] - adapts to your resolution and in-game settings[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crisper soundscape[/b] - dozens of missing effects restored (explosions, weapons, hyper jump, mission actions, UI sounds)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smarter enemies[/b] - NPCs no longer fire at you after death (they’ve finally learned some respect 👾)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better missions[/b] - fixes to duplicate mission triggers and death-while-landing exploits[/p][/*][*][p][b]Contraband system improved[/b] - get caught, and your goods are confiscated… unless you’ve got the credits to bribe your way out[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance optimizations[/b] - reduced memory usage for smoother gameplay[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Why This Matters[/b][/h3][p]This isn’t just bug-fixing. It’s about making [i]Stardust Origins[/i] ready for today’s screens and playstyles, while keeping the charm and challenge intact. We know many of you have been waiting for these fixes, thank you for your patience![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Let us know what you think of the new update, and as always - fly safe, pilot![/p][hr][/hr]

notes.title: Hints and tips for Stardust Origins
notes.content:
Here I will list some good hints and tips for starting out in Stardust Origins. I hope they will be useful to you all:

[h3]Quickly move on from The Void[/h3]
When starting the game, you're located in [b]The Void[/b] - The Void are empty areas in a star system and are useful for asteroid mining and space snake hunting. In the beginning of the game, you just want to move on. Select another planet in the same star system and press that 'Engage' button.

[h3]Fly faster on planets[/h3]
When entering a planet you're often a long way from a space station. Use [i]Time compression[/i] (default [b]key E[/b]) to let time pass faster and thus fly you faster on a planet.

[h3]Have patience doing battles[/h3]
First of all, avoid battles as much as you can, until you have a better ship, with armour and a larger laser. You will quickly be shot to pieces without it. 

[h3]An easy way to earn cash[/h3]
Take on those small parcel missions, where you have to fly to another station and deliver stuff. They're usually easy and give a good income.

[h3]A fast way to riches[/h3]
Locate a bank on a space station and take out a loan. This will help you upgrade your ship faster, and let you get on with cargo trading, pirate killing and asteroid mining.
[i]You [b]could[/b] also use your bank loan to buy shares on the stock market[/i]

[h3]Space snakes[/h3]
Space snakes can only be found in The Void. Usually they are shy, but also curious. If your ship is at a halt or flying very slowly they usually can't resist it, and must come and check you out.

I will write more hints and tips in the discussion sections :-)

notes.title: August 2021 devlog - All stories are done
notes.content:
Hi there,

This last month has been hectic with the release of the demo for the game. The demo consist of the current [i]very playable state[/i] of the game and is only limited in how far you can get in the story. You really should check it out, and maybe even help getting the game better by providing in-game feedback.

The most feedback for the game was that it is too difficult to get into. So I've spent a lot of time adding helpful tutorial texts to various areas of the game. I am planning to also create a FAQ or a "How to play" page on the Steam page. More on this at a later time. I admit that it IS difficult to start with. But since I have tried to create it in the spirit of the original [b]Frontier Elite II[/b] it SHOULD be difficult. You would have to think about how to get further in the game, but I can see now that the learning curve might have been too steep. So this has changed, and will be even more changed during the coming months.

The release of the demo has been overwhelming to me. Almost [b]3000[/b] of you steam users have added the demo to your library and I hope many more of you will give the game a try, though keeping in mind that is still is a work in progress. 

[h2]The development[/h2]
During this last month I have been working on the following areas:

[h3]Story missions[/h3]
All the story missions are now placed in the game. This means that I have a fully playable and completable game. This was a big milestone for me, as I now can concentrate on all the side missions, the "eyecandy", all the upgrades and the NPC's.

[h3]Reputation[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/bddbd98004bfca699874772dae15925d6e01d192.png[/img]
The actions you take in the universe will affect your reputation on the stations you visit. A good reputation opens up doors for more missions, for loans and stock trading, while a bad reputation quickly closes the doors. You build up a bad reputation by cancelling missions, shooting at innocents and generally being a bad apple. A good reputation is built by completing missions, aiding in fights and protecting innocent vessels and by donating money to worthy causes.

[h3]Rank[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/4e67706a788415f84c8afb2b4a6af0f3cbb999bc.png[/img]
You will rise in federal ranks by removing unwanted elements from the universe. As a bonus you also get bounty vouchers, which can be converted into money on stations.

[h3]Parcel delivery missions[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/1184b0f704f47ae42647cf66a96d9846132aa390.png[/img]
Added a new type of missions, the parcel delivery missions. These missions are an easy way to earn money and a good starting point, when you ship is small and your laser puny. They come in all kinds of deliveries and rewards.

[h3]UI improvements[/h3]
The UI has gotten updated with more icons and better text to make it easier to see where your mines are located and where missions are occuring. 

[h3]Tutorials[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/d2646c16991cd4e1627a8d3639d82cc5c0a577e1.png[/img]
Throughout the game I've added small tutorial dialogues which will popup when certain events occur. This should hopefully make it easier to see and know what to do in a given situation. These tutorial dialogues can quickly be removed by pressing the Escape key.

In the coming month the main goal is to implement all upgrades to your ship and then I need to do a lot of testing of the game. Speaking of testing. Do you want to be part of the test team for Stardust Origins? You get access to the current development build and you will receive a free key to the final game. Join my Discord and let me know :)

Discord [url=https://discord.gg/zQgwH3x]Join here[/url]

I believe this was all for this months devlog. I'm really looking forward to begin working on the "how-to-play" guide for the game, as I believe this document will be a goldmine in conquering the Stardust Origins. Thank you very much for reading.

notes.title: July 2021 devlog - Things are shaping up
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/9b969fb759dbfeb99a8a57b6ee3ff177c1b936d4.png[/img]
Welcome to the devlog of july. This past month has been used to fill more of the small gaps I still have in the game, and updates to already working parts. 

[h2]More story missions[/h2]
From the beginning of the game you're tasked with a mission. To find your way back and confront your father. For this you're getting story missions which slowly but surely will get you closer to this end goal. The stories in Stardust are varied in challenge and size and some of them, needs a lot of money to succesfully execute. I wont spoil anything regarding the story line, but I can assure you, that they wont be boring. So far I've done some 70% of the story missions, so it's all shaping up. I'm looking forward to developing the grand finale, and you're in for a treat :)

[h2]Autosave[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/2693870cc4c29b95d307d3aff4cd8384e7a41d62.png[/img]
Whenever you land on a planet, the game will be saved in an "autosave"-slot. This is to help you quickly get back to the last planet if you should have the misfortune of dying there.

[h2]Tutorials[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/2df1fbbf67281637b3ee699847cd8b855b09baea.gif[/img]
After the first alpha-tests of the game, it became clear that the player has a hard time figuring out what to do when starting out for the first time. So I've spent some time adding tutorial dialogues to various areas of the game, which will popup and give a small introduction to the action at hand.

[h2]Planetary information[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/290f84f2f1bac52558ed48fb64fdc1c151946af8.png[/img]
All stations provide planetary information, which give you valuable information about the place you're visiting. This can also give you a clue as to what commodities to bring along for a better price.

[h2]Universal average on prices[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/82e715827b070d80865a8ec3e3373b2bafdda1dd.png[/img]
Speaking of commodities. Now you can see the universal average on selling prices for all commodities. This is good information when deciding whether to sell your stuff on the current station. It's all about profit, right?

[h2]Fullscreen/Windowed[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/0b098dcf4f84090698517ecbe2700a7446dbcc12.png[/img]
I've also added the ability to change between fullscreen and windowed mode for the game, as I know some people enjoy playing in windowed mode. 

[h2]All the other stuff[/h2]
Apart from the areas mentioned above, I've also been working on the following:
[list]
[*] More reporting on your income/expenses, bankloan and shares
[*] Alien critters to infest various parts of the universe. Some are nice, and others a real pest
[*] Bug fixes from reports from the test team
[*] UI improvements
[/list]

I believe this is all for this devlog. Hope you've enjoyed reading it. And as always, feel free to give it a thumbs up or comment it.

You are also welcome to join the Discord [url=https://discord.gg/zQgwH3x]here[/url] to chat with the developer and the testers

notes.title: June 2021 devlog - Now we're getting somewhere
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/3b06ab5a0df7be34344afd791179f5dd502e0a3c.png[/img]
So another month has passed by and its time to dive into all the areas that I have been working on for the game. As the screenshot above shows, I have added stock markets to selected stations. This is stations on planets with a high teck level and on planets with a decent amount of civilization. On the stock markets you can buy and sell shares to help increase your wealth. Shares doing great will payout dividend once a year.

The main focus of this months development have been to add music and sounds to the game, but also to add a lot of missing information dialogs. I will briefly go through some of them below.

[h2]Service ship and compartments[/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/b3e06772fa1dc10bf68dfbc1cff9d0b262f12909.png[/img]
It is essential that you service your ship at regular intervals or it will start to fail at the most crucial moments. You can risk misjumps when you fly to other planets or systems, you can risk loosing cargo or even your life, is service is neglected. So pay attention to the service intervals.

[h2]Bank[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/9dc8bbbeb479e3d647b26135e220d21c232abd5f.png[/img]
Some stations contains a bank where you can get a little extra money at (maybe) affordable rates. Choose the loan you wish to take and enjoy that extra cash. But be warned. Not paying back a bank loan will get you some nasty ships on your tail.

[h2]Revised the commodity market[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/ea94e2e673305c384151ea376bca48584f6ac892.gif[/img]
I've changed the way you buy and sell commodities on the market. Now its done using a slider, giving you better precision on how many you want to buy and sell.

[h2]Income/Expense report[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/0b75ebb013d06b9f6a47c66b469b772e7bf748cc.png[/img]
All income and expenses are now saved in the income/expense report, so you can keep track of your money spendings and income. It will show the last 60 entries.

[h2]Cargo hull inventory[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/7ad2e87730475b65625d41b0950c81380e42742a.png[/img]
The cargo hull inventory shows what you currently have in your cargo hull and it gives you the possibility to jettison some of it. Jettison'ing some cargo can be a great getaway if you have pirates on your tail.

[h2]Other additions and improvements[/h2]
In addition to sounds and dialogs, I have also worked on other areas of the game:
[list]
[*] Changed the way NPC's fly. They now use newtonian physics meaning that they use their thrusters to break and turn just like the player
[*] Added a new NPC passenger carrier. It will fly between stations or between planets with passengers
[*] Added more key bindings and options for the options-screen
[*] Added pause mode, where you can either save the game or change options
[*] Added new star system discovery - Once in a while new star systems gets discovered, expanding the universe
[*] Translated the game to German and Spanish. More languages are in the pipeline. I'm using [url=https://www.localizor.com/stardust-origins]Localizor[/url] for crowdfunded localizations
[/list]

[url=https://discord.gg/zQgwH3x][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/d784775c62092ba73584824781f1b7e24fd42b9f.png[/img][/url]
Join my Discord server for more updates and friendly chats with the developer ːsteamhappyː [url=https://discord.gg/zQgwH3x]Discord[/url]

I believe that is all for this devlog. Hope you enjoyed reading it and as always give a thumbs up or a comment if you have anything on your mind.

notes.title: May 2021 devlog - A lot has happened
notes.content:
[h1]May 2021 devlog[/h1]
Hi, and welcome to the devlog of may 2021. Since the last devlog a lot of progress has been made in various areas of the game, including beginning the preparations for a DEMO. Yes, you read it right! I will release a demo of the game, showcasing many of the elements in the game. If everything shapes up, it should be ready for the Steam Fall festival.

So what has been done since the last devlog? Well a lot I think :) - Lets dive right in to it!

[h2]Main screen[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/02c0dbcdab82bd1feed5222c8124a0d00d18af66.png[/img]
The main screen has been revamped with new fonts, a new headline, new changing backgrounds and a rotating procedurally generated planet. You also get random tips for optimizing your playing experience.

[h2]Options screen[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/0e737733312b5113495229e9fcb72c9712e059b1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/2bec1a67766ec3d54805662f05dc5c401fc4a94b.png[/img]
Now you can change settings for the game and remap the keybindings to your play style. A few more settings and keys will be added later on, but for now, you're good to go. 

[h2]New game screen[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/702a4667947654378dd143d99357d8f3f5af9ac4.gif[/img]
In the new screen you are able to create your own personalized character for the game. It has a lot of options and you can create more than 2 million unique appearences. It is also where you select your initial ship to help in your adventure.

[h2]New mission types[/h2]
[h3]Goods missions[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/8f12027b64f63cd6127ab0651eadb2e19839c23c.png[/img]
A lot of different goods hauling missions have been added to the game. Each station offers different kinds of missions for transporting goods to other stations, both on same planet, in the same system or between systems. Prices will vary according to travel time, deadlines and potential risks.

[h3]Passenger missions[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/55161b4d9db7a0994bd36c3e2c5c7a826708b84b.png[/img]
The universe is a busy place and people needs transporting from place to place. You can take up the role as passenger carrier and transport people around. The rewards can be big, but so can the risks. And you need a passenger cabin in your ships hull.

[h2]Fines and bounty rewards[/h2]
Fines and bounty rewards has also been implemented. A bounty is a price on your head, which will be added when you kill other ships without prior provocations. Note though that this only happens if there are any witness to your crime. If you have the [b]Ship Scanner[/b] attached, you can see if a targeted ship is wanted and have a bounty on its head. To receive the money from killing a wanted ship, you need to go to the [b]Security[/b] section of a station and redeem a bounty voucher.
Fines are given to you, if you fail to complete missions, which have a fine attached to it. Fines are paid off at the Security section and failing to pay fines will result in your reputation being lowered.

[h2]Reputation[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/2a02ba5b0330de3988849f98259fd813545a79be.png[/img]
Your actions in the game will have an impact on your universal reputation which again will influence which types of missions are available and which function of a station you are able to use. So keep a good reputation! This includes completing missions, paying off your fines and generally just be a decent guy.

[h2]Legal status[/h2]
I have also added a legal status to every ship. Your legal status represents how the police and other ships see you. A legal status of outlaw will make the police attack you on sight. The only way to reset your legal status by paying off the police at the Security section on stations. Your legal status is changed when you attack unprovoked AND being witnessed by other ships.

[h2]Demo coming[/h2]
As I mentioned in the beginning, I'm working on making a demo ready for you to play. It will be ready for the Steam Fall Festival (date unknown right now). For this demo, I need to add sound and music which are nonexisting as of now. I hope to have more information regarding this at a later stage.

[h2]Localization[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/99ff3dca9e143e094254598715a7118447577542.png[/img]
I've added my game to [b]Localizor[/b], an online crowd translation tool to have it translated. This should make it possible for me to release the game with these languages:
[list]
[*] English
[*] French
[*] Spanish
[*] German
[*] Russian
[*] Danish
[/list]
[b]You[/b] can contribute to the translations and will be able to receive a [i]free Steam key[/i] for the game when it releases. You will also be mentioned in the Credits for the game. Just follow this link [url=https://www.localizor.com/stardust-origins]Localization Stardust Origins[/url] and signup on the page. The game could really use your help in this!

[b]That's all folks![/b] At least for this devlog. I'm still busy working on the game and still enjoying it a lot! I hope you will too, when you can get your hands on it. 

[i]If you liked this devlog, please give it a thumbs up! If you have questions or ideas for other ways to present the devlog, dont hesitate to give me shout on the forum. Press the Discuss button below, and we'll take it from there.[/i]

notes.title: April 2021 devlog - Permits and story missions
notes.content:
[h1]April 2021 devlog[/h1]
Hi there,

since march I have been all over the game, doing changes and additions in all directions - But all is needed in order to give the best experience for the game. Here are the highlights of the previous month:

[h2]Mining permits[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/2b87f47f8a6ba88e5544938324eebcd6c3fd0023.png[/img]
You can't just fly around and build mining stations anywhere. You need permits to do it. At every station, you can buy a permit, which can be limited to only one planet, and with a deadline or it can be a wildcard, you can use everywhere. A mining permit grants you the rights to build one station. And you can buy all the permits you like. [i]Mining asteroids won't require permits[/i].

[h2]Mining station maintenance[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/6ea4573088628751dd0d4251598d796caf773c5e.png[/img]
Once you have your mining station set up, you can customize the look of it, and how it operates. It is also here you can upgrade your station to be even bigger and more profitable.

[h2]Defensive mines[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/3a442bf44a07c4720eca33d4819ff9f98bd900da.gif[/img]
The defensive mines are a great way to protect what is dear to you. You can carry up to 8 mines at a time and deploy them using one of your secondary actions functions. The mines are magnetic and will get pulled towards all ships close by (incl. your own!). They explode when close to a target and shoots our deadly darts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/58635baaef486c3508ebb3115e082373c42a72f3.gif[/img]

[h2]Cluster bombs[/h2]
The same goes for cluster bombs, with the biggest difference being that the cluster bomblets have no magnetic abilities, but they WILL explode when a ship is close to them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/b7ca0f3c2125c6051f202091c326ab0e24a65980.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/009278b3824129a6050f8e995d263f2eea4b1d71.gif[/img]

[h2]The story and missions[/h2]
Even though [b]Stardust Origins[/b] is a game where you choose your own adventure, there's an unfolding story going throughout the game. You need to complete this story in order to win the game. But its up to you how and when you do it. A lot of story missions have already been implemented (I'm not going to reveil how many), but lately I've added story mission 5 and 6 and can tease a little bit about one of them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/941127bd8ef080a2636d8c70dbb942ddbe266077.gif[/img]

I believe that is all for this devlog. As you can see, work is still ongoing, with updates almost every day. You can follow me on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/PetSkull]@Petskull[/url] where I post all updates. 

You can also [url=https://petskullgames.com]join my newsletter[/url] to get news on the development and to get tips and tricks for the game not mentioned anywhere else.

[b]See you in the next devlog![/b]

notes.title: March 2021 devlog - Mining stations
notes.content:
[h3]My dream game[/h3]
[i]I'm not sure if I have told you this before, but this game is the fulfillment of a long lasting dream I've had for many years. To create a new Elite Frontier experience, but in 2D and topdown. This means, a game where you can explore planets, mine asteroids, trade goods, kill pirates, help the police, buy bigger and better ships, get good reputation and solve mission stories and do it all at your own pace. [/i]

[h3]The mining stations[/h3]
My main focus since last devlog has been to implement the mining stations. Mining stations are a vital part in the game, if you want ot increase your wealth the easy way. Mining stations come in 4 sizes and can be upgraded from smaller to bigger stations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/02d38c819e4409a46b5a88729535fa4c5787dc86.gif[/img] 

In order for you to be able to deploy a mining station, you need to have room for it in your hull. The mining station comes as a tight packed compartment, which will assemble itself on deployment. Once deployed your hull is empty for other uses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/183ce9363773057dbfdf4e69cbfb56c3245cd47d.gif[/img]
Using the [b]Ore locator[/b] you can find the best spots on a planet to deploy your station. Look for areas with a lot of ore in the ground and place your station. This will maximize your revenue.

[h3]The crew[/h3]
Next step is to hire an efficient crew to help mining for the ores. Mining can't begin before the crew is hired. [i]Be sure to find the crew with high efficiency and low salary[/i]. New crew members will be available every day. If you fire a crew member you will have to pay him the salary owed PLUS 3 months of pay.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/d8092765f6933258bdef8bcba0b68363d0dbcb20.png[/img]
Once a month the crew needs their salary. This amount will be deducted from your cash. And be sure to have enough cash, otherwise the crew will stop working. 

[h3]Selling the ore[/h3]
The mined ore needs to be transported to a planet station to be sold on the stations market. You have two ways of doing this. You can transfer the ore to your own ship and fly to a station to sell it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/a1db2f10adc0a5fe5eb104c4fb7e42768875a9db.gif[/img]

[h3]Let the droids work for you[/h3]
Or you can buy a mining freighter, which can do the job for you. This droid ship will fill its hull with ore from the mining station and fly to the nearest station to sell it for you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/0c573f3f6fdfb09d8af45d063889731463da1182.png[/img]

When an ore field has dried out, you will get a notice and you can then dissasemble the station and move it to a new location. Just remember to have room enough in your hull for the packed mining station.

[h3]Wrapping it up[/h3]
That's it for this devlog. Work is going as planned and the amount of tasks I need done, is slowly getting smaller. At the same time I still come up with new ideas for things I really want to add to the game, to make it even better. Remember to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/816850/Stardust_Tycoon/]Wislist the game[/url] if this kind of game is to your liking. It means a lot to me to get wishlists, as it encourages me to deliver the best game possible and to give you a great gaming experience.


Until the next devlog - Hope to see you again :) - Follow my almost daily updates on twitter https://twitter.com/PetSkull

notes.title: February 2021 devlog - Almost ready for mining stations
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/1d618568f01b0211237c3ece244499c6e633f8a3.png[/img]

Already well into february and work is still going on with Stardust Tycoon. I'm working on it as often as I'm able to, and still enjoy it very much. With this devlog I will highlight the major updates to the game.

What has been made since the last devlog:

[list]
[*] Added different engine types
[*] Added 2 different missile types
[*] Added the ship buying section of a station. New ships will be available every day
[*] Added the upgrade section of a station. Here you can buy and sell upgrades to your ship. The availability of upgrades are dependant on the planets tech. level
[*] Added a mining station, which can mine for ressources on a planet. You will be able to either land on it and move ore to your ship or you can buy a robot freighter ship, which can do this for you.
[*] Redid some of the graphics for the game
[*] Added more main story quests, which are part of the developing story of the game
[*] A lot of bugs has been fixed and the game runs great on my development machines. Average fps is at 1000-1500 without capping.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/af3ba1da41a28919c38df821b951aaea79b5205f.gif[/img]

Next up is finishing everything regarding planetary mining - I need to add an ore finder, so you know where to place your mining stations, to get the highest return. I also am working on adding more quests to the system, both story and sidequests. 

I've also begun the process of finding and adding sound effects to the game - But this has lowest priority right now.

Until the next devlog - See you :) - Oh, and do follow my regular updates on twitter https://twitter.com/PetSkull

notes.title: January 2021 devlog - Big news!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/cf108b25ffeeb0a320262ca5ec402f98d7925047.gif[/img]

Hi there fellow gamers,

Happy New Year to you all - Hope you all had a nice day and got into 2021 in the best manner possible :-)

It is time for the first devlog of 2021. The biggest news first! I've partnered with [b]Thomas Cowling[/b] a story and mission writer, who will contribute with main story missions and side quests to the game. He also is a great idea-man and has already come up with new great ideas for the game. This is so good, and I'm very pleased to have him onboard.

Also I've persuaded my talented son Sebastian [b]https://www.artstation.com/sebastianpagh[/b] to do the Steam page art for the game. I'm really excited by this - He's already working on the images and they look really good!

This is the list of things I've been working on since the last time:

[list]
[*] A brand new prolog has been created - Giving you an insight to what will come
[*] The dialogue system has been implemented
[*] Work has been done to implement story missions
[*] The first sidequests have been added
[*] Numerous bug fixes and optimizations
[/list]

Next up on my agenda is the ship shop and upgrade shop located on all stations. The assortment will differ from station to station, according to availability and technological level. But you should be able to upgrade all ships with some helpful stuff.

If you're interested in hearing more or have any questions, don't hesitate to use the discussion forum. And do give me a thumbs up, if you read this and enjoyed it. Thanks! :)

Until next time...

notes.title: December 2020 devlog - Still working
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/ba20dd89b68b205ab59259aa30515ba690239ae7.png[/img]

Hi there,

time for another devlog! I'm still chucking along on the code and getting longer every day. There are a lot of systems in [b]Stardust Tycoon[/b] which needs to fit together, so a lot of work has been made to the core engine. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/76487003ed99a8750349f530f1a241ddc85ddac2.png[/img]

This is the list of major things I've been working on:

[list]
[*] NPC's now interact with each other. Pirates will hunt freigthers and freighters can call for help and police can respond to distress calls.
[*] Pirates will have their bounties increased each time they get reported
[*] Wanted fellons are listed on all stations along with their bounty
[*] Saving and loading the game state is implemented. This means you can save the game anywhere
[*] First part of the storyline has been added
[*] Numerous bug fixes and optimizations
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/51ef9bff1e2b0078d899e26e74e94597e51272d8.gif[/img]

Things are shaping up just like I want them to. I have so many ideas for the game and try to limit myself in order to not get too excited about little extra features and still work on the core game. But all ideas are noted and some of them will be implemented in the first version. There's still a long way to go, but my goal of releasing in 2021 is still my marker and what I aim for. 

Happy holidays to all of you and I hope you will get into a corona free 2021.

notes.title: Still working on the new version
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/a6d8d36636aaf0d6192d080ca71acbc69721fcaf.gif[/img]

Work is still going as planned and with more work hours than initially anticipated. This I really like! 

So far I've been working the following areas:

[list]
[*] Hyperjumping from planet to planet
[*] New area, the asteroid fields - Here you will be able to mine minerals
[*] Market prices for all stations has been implemented. Prices will change according to supply and demand and the planets needs for certain comodities
[*] All selectable objects on a planet can be selected and communicated with (still ongoing)
[*] Planet map with all selectable objects shown
[*] Tutorials have been added to some functions and more will come
[*] New general dialog layout
[/list]

Next big step is to implement the different NPC's. I will be starting out with the Freighter-type, as this one hauls cargo from planet to planet and thereby influences the prices on the stations.

I will keep you posted! And please dont hesitate to comment to these post either directly here or in the community.

notes.title: Moving to early access soon
notes.content:
[h3]Long time no hear from me. I'm not proud of it, but that's the fact [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/6f66952a44931eb3f32d309da80ea1ff3b5411f3.png[/img]

But today, I have some long awaited great news for you! :) - I will change Stardust Tycoon into an early access game soon, and will set a low price on it, for as long as it is in EA. 

The reason behind this, is that I want you, the community to get a feel for the game and help me with valuable feedback regarding the gameplay and mechanics. Being a sole developer, it is hard to get around each corner in this game, which have grown bigger and bigger - Way bigger than I first had in mind. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33335188/d0ef464777626db891aabeabe7f1e55dcff7462c.png[/img]

I hope you will help me bringing this game into the greatest state, where all will enjoy the spirit of the old spacetrading sims :)

I will make a new announcement, once I get a runnable version ready of the game.
